biotools.summary: StrainVis is a web-based platform designed for the interactive visualization and analysis of within-species microbial diversity. It uniquely integrates outputs from both Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI) and Average Pairwise Synteny (APSS) tools, enabling comprehensive strain-level comparisons.
